items.requirement: Every supported exact identity kind validates identity, version, scope, and caps.
Subscribed panels receive only exact compatible references from the Workspace-scoped store.
Array index, row order, display label, fuzzy match, and unit guessing cannot create selection.
Canonical <=2048-byte URL state restores exactly and rejects stale/foreign/non-canonical tokens.
Explicit Pin uses the existing Workspace PATCH/ETag path and survives reload without implicit writes.
Inspector exposes exact selected identity, compatibility, source references, and bounded navigation.
Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, keyboard, mobile bottom sheet, clearing, and multi-selection evidence pass.
